scope: CEO Wave3: turn the validated disagreement finding into mechanism, in the exceedance product. d = |pred_weekly_ridge - pred_adjusted| at issuance; d-conditioned exceedance probabilities vs Wave1 global CDF, on the SAME frozen reserved targets. Candidates fit on dev only.
model: adjusted (Wave1 winner); d available in both archived reports

candidates.tercile: dev d tercile cut-points (q33,q67); per-tercile residual CDFs; row classified by its d
candidates.scaled: dev scaled residuals r/s_i with s_i = d_i/median(d_dev); query (C-pred)/s_row with s_row = d_row/median(d_dev); mirrors the frozen scaled-calibration rule

probability: P(y>C) = 1 - F(query), clipped [0.005, 0.995]; global CDF = Wave1 pooled dev residuals (H3+H4)
metrics: Brier vs outcome on reserved; per-tercile breakdown for the tercile candidate; reliability on the high-d tercile
verdict_rule: D_MECHANISM_WORKS if either candidate Brier < global Brier on BOTH levels (P75/P90). Otherwise NO_EDGE. Retrospective consumed data; no production claim.
limitations: Same consumed window as Wave1 (dev fit, reserved eval); single model; terciles coarse.
